evidence.quote: Reproduces the missing-id failure pattern from prod

observations.why: Framing a known production failure as a test case carries low-arousal, mildly negative valence — clinical reproduction of a defect, not alarm.
Modal 'must' with semicolon urgency registers a hard constraint under pressure — high-arousal negative valence of a failure to avoid.
A positive outcome requirement stated in settled, declarative register — low-arousal satisfaction of a correct result expected.
